    <h2>Why We Created the Docent Program</h2>
    
    <div class="two-col" style="margin-top:2rem;">
      <div>
        <p>Conferences can be incredible experiences — packed with learning, networking, and inspiration. But for first-time attendees, they can also feel overwhelming, isolating, and hard to navigate.</p>
        <p>We started the JSM Docent Program because we believe that a single friendly conversation can transform someone's entire JSM experience. When a newcomer has someone they can turn to with questions — even simple ones like "where's the best place for lunch?" or "which sessions would you recommend?" — they feel welcomed, valued, and part of the community.</p>
        <p>The word <em>docent</em> comes from the Latin <em>docēre</em>, meaning "to teach." But our docents aren't lecturers — they're guides, mentors, and welcoming ambassadors who help first-timers get the most out of their conference experience.</p>
      </div>
